turns.text: Make a workflow that runs a review agent on every pull request opened in the web repo.
I proposed pr-review with a github.pull_request trigger (opened, synchronize) and an image step using the claude profile that reviews the diff and posts a comment through github.create_comment.
Only on opened, not on every push. Pushes would cost too much.
Removed synchronize; it triggers on opened only.
Added `when: ${{ !trigger.pull_request.draft }}`. Validation passed and you saved it as pr-review v1.
